title: Formal unramifiedness of a flat finite extension with source depth two on the boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $p:E\to L$ be finite and flat [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and suppose its restriction over $U$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume $\operatorname{depth}(\mathcal O_{E,z})\geq2$ whenever $p(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Then $p$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. No smoothness or target-depth assumption is made.

proof.text: Finiteness makes E locally Noetherian by Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian. Apply the already proved depth bound to each stalk as a module over itself; Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim identifies its support dimension with its Krull dimension.

The restricted map over U is etale. Compose it with the open immersion U into L, then use morphismRestrict_ι to obtain a formally unramified map on the source open p inverse U. This provides a neighbourhood for every point over U.

At a boundary point z, depth at least two and the stalk dimension bound give local dimension at least two, hence positive dimension. At any dimension-one generalization z′, lying outside U would give 2 <= depth <= dimension = 1, a contradiction. Thus z′ lies over U and has the formally unramified neighbourhood of the preceding step. Apply the finite-flat codimension-one local criterion to z and turn its etale neighbourhood into a formally unramified one.

Choose the formally unramified neighbourhoods just proved for all source points. Their supremum is top since each point belongs to its own neighbourhood. Mathlib IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_iSup_eq_top for FormallyUnramified assembles them to obtain FormallyUnramified p. No definition chooses data from an existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EY6(3), assembly of depth bound, open restriction, local criterion 0BJH, and source locality; the assembly is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_flat_depth_two_finite_extension
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p] [Flat p] [Etale (p ∣_ U)]
    (hboundary : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    FormallyUnramified p
